scope: Assisted installation: real automatic loose-file/native installation plus a staged forge manager queue. Not a tested one-click download-and-install collection.
source: User-pasted DEEF Notion modlist; only requested first-person replacement is substituted.

mods.name: Breakpoint Modding Starter Essentials
mods.note: Default base pack. Install ONLY DataPC_patch_01.forge and DataPC_Resources_patch_01.forge before any forge mods. Includes individual buildtables and the vanilla meta fix. The helper backs up both original forges. Do not reapply over installed mods.

mods.name: Pre-Patch + Unlock Everything + Buildtables + Meta
mods.note: Optional alternative to 1492, never stack both. Select the META variant if you want Unlock Everything. The helper installs only the two required pre-patch forges; other optional components require their own instructions.

mods.name: Play With Vanilla Players / vanilla metafiles
mods.note: Already supplied by the 1492 base pack, or by the META variant of 1495. Do not install it three times. Matchmaking compatibility is not proof that every runtime mod or combination is compatible.

mods.name: Nexus mod 1195 (hidden)

mods.name: Sound Edits - disable hitmarker sounds (1.0)
mods.note: Choose Disable Hitmarker Sound Effects v1.0. v1.1 is marked BROKEN by the author. The helper copies supplied .pck files to sounddata/pc with backups; it cannot infer a version from the audio bytes.

mods.name: Sound Edits - disable head/body shot sounds (1.0)
mods.note: Choose Disable Head and Body Shot Sound Effects v1.0, NOT 1.1. Supply this separate file as well if you want both changes.

Install ReShade with full add-on support first. Helper copies ONLY ShaderToggler.addon64 and ShaderToggler.ini, never the bundled dxgi.dll. CapsLock is the HUD toggle. Do not overwrite this config with 1310.

mods.name: No-HUD-No-Effects - Toggle Bullet Tracers - Fog and MORE
mods.note: Alternative to HUD Toggle 1247; shares ShaderToggler files. DX11 only. Disabled by default; choose one configuration or deliberately merge toggle groups in the add-on UI.

mods.name: Deef's LoFidelity Reshade (For First and Third Person)
mods.note: Install ReShade first. LoFidelity also requires Shaders and Textures from RECORDED or NOT (Ready or Not mod 2634). Select one active preset in ReShade. Do not overwrite a first-person d3d11.dll.

mods.name: RECORDED or NOT shaders/textures
mods.note: Download the author-provided RECORDED or NOT files; copy its Shaders and Textures to the game's reshade-shaders. This dependency is linked by LoFidelity; no third-party shader bytes are bundled.

mods.name: Tier 1 Imports Wraith Ops ReShade
mods.note: Obtain the Wraith Ops archive from this channel. Follow its README. Keep both presets available if wanted, but select one active ReShade preset; do not combine preset INIs by overwriting.

mods.name: Just A Dot
mods.note: Add the requested colour/settings to your active preset using the included screenshot instructions. Enable xhair.fx. Follow its controller instructions; copying its INI alone does not merge it into another preset.

mods.name: Spartan UI - blast-radius removal
mods.note: Separate Spartan UI download. Configure blast-radius removal using its README. Inspect any supplied graphics proxy first: native first person owns d3d11.dll and dinput8.dll. Never blindly overwrite either.

mods.name: Spartan gameplay (Cheat Engine table)
mods.note: Full Spartan is a Cheat Engine runtime table, not a forge mod. Follow its author's startup guide each session. It requires the author's BattlEye setup; this helper does not silently change anti-cheat or launch scripts. Co-op behavior is not guaranteed.

mods.name: Easy First Person v3 / Native First Person 0.2.10
mods.note: Bundled EXACT uploaded v3 / internal 0.2.10. Default: DX11, FOV 120, vanilla ADS, safe interaction fallback, 10 cm clearance, body follow off, Numpad0 toggle, start in third person. No separate camera/DoF package.
